crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

translations.web: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
translations.bsb: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
translations.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
translations.asv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and arrayed him in a purple garment;
